core_categories: Health Insurance; Pharmacy Benefit Management; Retail Pharmacy; Specialty Pharmacy; Clinical Care Services
specialty_focus: CVS Health is a diversified health solutions company combining health insurance (Aetna), pharmacy benefit management (Caremark), and retail/specialty pharmacy services. It operates thousands of retail pharmacy locations and provides clinical care through MinuteClinic, focusing on prescription fulfillment and chronic disease management. It does not specifically specialize in wearable medical devices.
